task_definition.task_description: Check the current time in New York, then look up Alice's contact card. After that, get a quote for AAPL and check the Yahoo market window status. Please archive that market window information as a high-priority email for Alice with the title "2026-02-22", and finally, place an equity order for AAPL for the amount of 10000.5.
